The '''2009 Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation election''' was conducted on 23 November 2009<ref>{{Cite news |date=2009-11-26 |title=GHMC election results today |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad/ghmc-election-results-today/articleshow/5269659.cms |access-date=2023-07-09 |issn=0971-8257}}</ref> to elect members to all 150 wards of the [[municipal corporation]]. These were the first elections since to the GHMC since its creation in 2007. About 43% of the 57 lakh (5.7 million) voters cast their vote in the polls. The [[Indian National Congress]] and the [[All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen]] formed the government in a post-poll agreement.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2009-11-26 |title=Congress, MIM ahead in Hyderabad civic polls |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/Congress-MIM-ahead-in-Hyderabad-civic-polls/article16894302.ece |access-date=2023-07-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230709065803/https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/Congress-MIM-ahead-in-Hyderabad-civic-polls/article16894302.ece |archive-date=2023-07-09 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref> [[Banda Karthika Reddy]], corporator from [[Tarnaka]] became the mayor from the [[Indian National Congress|Congress Party]] and [[Tolichowki|Toli Chowki]] corporator [[Jaffer Hussain]] became deputy mayor from [[All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen|AIMIM]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2009-12-04 |title=Karthika Reddy elected as GHMC Mayor |language=en-IN |work=The Hindu |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/Karthika-Reddy-elected-as-GHMC-Mayor/article16851521.ece |access-date=2023-07-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230709074143/https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/andhra-pradesh/Karthika-Reddy-elected-as-GHMC-Mayor/article16851521.ece |archive-date=2023-07-09 |issn=0971-751X}}</ref>

== Election schedule ==
The Andhra Pradesh State Election Commission announced the schedule for the GHMC election on 29 October 2009.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2009-10-29 |title=It’s final: GHMC elections on Nov 23 |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/hyderabad/2009/oct/29/its-final-ghmc-elections-on-nov-23-99215.html |access-date=2023-07-09 |website=The New Indian Express}}</ref>
